# Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2020

**An Ordinance on Collection of Corresponding Barangay Clearance Fee in the Application for Any Business Related Transactions**

## Summary

This ordinance streamlines the process of business registration in Pitogo by authorizing the Municipality to collect barangay clearance fees at the municipal level for business-related transactions. It aims to promote a more efficient revenue collection process and a friendlier atmosphere for taxpayers and investors, in line with the Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Delivery of Government Services Act (RA 11032).

## Key Provisions

1. **Coverage** (Section 1): Applies only to the issuance of Barangay Clearance for business permit and locational clearance (as a requirement for building permits) at the Municipality. Other clearances must still be obtained at the Barangay.

2. **Definitions** (Section 2):
   - **Barangay Clearance** — documents issued by barangays related to business permits and locational/zoning clearance
   - **Barangay Clearance Fees** — amounts imposed by barangays through ordinance, collected by the Municipality for business permit and locational clearance
   - **Business Permit** — document from the municipal government via its [[Business Permits and Licensing Office]] (BPLO)
   - **Locational Clearance** — clearance issued by the Zoning Administrator for projects allowed under municipal ordinances

3. **Authority to Collect** (Section 3): The Municipality of Pitogo is authorized to collect Barangay Clearance Fees, subject to remittance to the subject Barangay.

4. **Rate of Fee** (Section 4): Computed in accordance with the subject Barangay Revenue Ordinance (attached as Annex "A").

5. **Electronic Signature** (Section 5): The Punong Barangay's electronic signature shall appear on all clearances issued.

6. **Reporting and Remittance** (Section 6): The Municipality shall remit collected fees to the subject Barangay not later than seven (7) working days of the ensuing month, with the list of issued Building and Business Permits.
